verdict.rationale: Statsig's official MCP server lets users ask questions about their Statsig data and experiments using AI, including from ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Codex. That is the product's own documented route to AI-generated answers from user data. However, the AI runs in external clients rather than inside the Statsig console, and nothing shows proactive insights or suggestions generated by the product itself. missing for 10: native in-console AI insights or suggestions, evidence of AI-generated recommendations from experiment or analytics data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
